variants.display_name: PaddleOCR-VL-1.6 · vLLM · 4 proposals · Current routing control
variants.change_description: Fresh retained control: regions assigned round-robin as soon as they are submitted.

outcome_note.summary: The fresh four-proposal control passed all 30 calls at 3.03 s p50, 15.77 s p95 and 35.83 pages/min, reproducing the retained configuration.
outcome_note.next: Shared admission alone did not help. Choosing an available GPU improved p50 and throughput with a small p95 regression; profile the resulting NACA bottleneck before the next comparison.

suite_runtime.scope: Evaluator process, worker setup, warm-ups, measured calls, validation and comparison. Excludes inference-server startup, environment inventory, reference capture and profiling.

variants.display_name: PaddleOCR-VL-1.6 · vLLM · 4 proposals · Shared queue, round-robin
variants.change_description: Keep fixed round-robin destinations; admit at most 8 requests per GPU across page workers.

outcome_note.summary: Shared admission with fixed destinations passed all 30 calls but provided no gain: 3.06 s p50, 15.80 s p95 and 35.64 pages/min, slightly worse than the fresh control.
outcome_note.next: Available-GPU assignment improved p50 at the same capacity, confirming that the assignment policy helped. Profile NACA, which now determines the pooled median, and retain the p95 tradeoff in comparisons.

variants.display_name: PaddleOCR-VL-1.6 · vLLM · 4 proposals · Shared queue, available GPU
variants.change_description: At the same 8-request admission limit, select a GPU when capacity becomes available.

outcome_note.summary: Choosing an available GPU improved p50 from 3.03 to 2.91 s and throughput to 36.20 pages/min; p95 worsened from 15.77 to 16.05 s. All 30 calls passed.
outcome_note.next: Fresh NACA profiling shows 85.5% OCR, no vLLM queue, and about three running requests per GPU on average. Compare admission limits 4/8/12 at fixed server concurrency eight; check the Census p95 tradeoff.
